always_encrypted.description: Specifies whether TLS is required. Must be set when using `SshTunnel` connection

aws_region_code.description: AWS region code. Required when `auth_method` is set to `AWS_IAM`

connection_type.description: Connection method. Supported values: `Directly`, `SshTunnel`, `ProxyAgent`, `PrivateLink`. Default: `Directly`. Note: PrivateLink is only supported for cloud-hosted PostgreSQL (RDS, Aurora, Azure, GCP).

external_id.description: AWS external ID for authentication. Auto-generated from group ID when `auth_method` is set to `AWS_IAM`

password.description: Database user password. Required for PASSWORD authentication

role_arn.description: AWS IAM role ARN for authentication. Required when `auth_method` is set to `AWS_IAM`

tunnel_host.description: SSH server hostname. Required when `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`

tunnel_port.description: SSH server port. Required when `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`

tunnel_user.description: SSH user name. Required when `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`

user.description: Database user name. Required for PASSWORD authentication
